name: Cataphoria
source:
Where do you find belonging in a world that you have never belonged to?

When you aren't I, and I aren't you.

[From [url=https://smallcritter.itch.io/cataphoria]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个你从未属于过的世界里，你在哪里可以找到归属感？

当你不是我的时候，我也不是你的时候。

[来自[url=https://smallcritter.itch.io/cataphoria]Itch.io[/url]]
